_comment: Camera roles set by hand. These beat whatever the scene descriptions
suggest, and are read fresh on every report, so editing this file is
enough - no restart, no code change.
'indoor' means the camera that answers 'is the clinic working?' - the
consulting room. Opening, closing and lunch are read from it alone.
'outdoor' means everything else: a courtyard, an entrance, or a waiting
area outside the consulting room. Those views cannot tell whether the
clinic is open, so they are excluded from the times.
Only list a camera when the automatic reading is wrong. Every other
clinic here is inferred correctly and needs no entry.
